name: outlook-mail
description: Microsoft 365 (Outlook) mailbox integration via Microsoft Graph — list, search, and read messages, browse mail folders, move messages, create drafts, and send mail for a mailbox. Uses app-only (client-credentials) auth and works with Microsoft 365 work/school accounts. Message bodies are read as plain text.
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: Microsoft 365 mailbox messages via Microsoft Graph (app-only)

fields.label: Directory (Tenant) ID
fields.helpText: The Azure AD tenant ID (GUID) of your Microsoft 365 organization.

fields.label: Application (Client) ID
fields.helpText: The Application (client) ID of the app registration.

fields.label: Client Secret
fields.helpText: A client secret for the app registration. Requires the Mail.Read application permission with admin consent; Mail.ReadWrite for move/draft; Mail.Send for sending.

fields.label: Mailbox (UPN/email)
fields.helpText: The mailbox to operate on (app-only requires an explicit user).

tools.name: mail.list_messages
tools.description: List the most recent messages in a mail folder (default inbox), newest first, with subject, sender, received time, read state, and attachment flag.

folder.description: Mail folder id or well-known name (inbox, drafts, sentitems, deleteditems, junkemail, archive). Default inbox.

tools.name: mail.search_messages
tools.description: Search messages across the mailbox using either a free-text search phrase or an OData filter expression. Exactly one of search or filter must be given; search results have no guaranteed order (Graph forbids $orderby with $search).

search.description: Free-text search phrase (matches subject, body, sender, etc.). Mutually exclusive with filter.

filter.description: OData $filter expression, e.g. "isRead eq false" or "from/emailAddress/address eq 'a@b.com'". Mutually exclusive with search.

tools.name: mail.get_message
tools.description: Get a single message: plain-text body, to/cc recipients, and attachment metadata (names, sizes, and content types — no attachment contents).

tools.name: mail.list_folders
tools.description: List the mail folders in the mailbox with total and unread item counts.

tools.name: mail.move_message
tools.description: Move a message to another mail folder (by folder id or well-known name such as archive or deleteditems).

destinationId.description: Destination folder id or well-known name (inbox, archive, deleteditems, junkemail, drafts, sentitems)

tools.name: mail.create_draft
tools.description: Create a draft message (never sends). Either a new draft (subject, to, body) or a reply draft to an existing message via replyToMessageId.

subject.description: Draft subject. Required for a new draft; optional override for a reply draft.

to.description: Recipient email addresses. Required for a new draft; optional override for a reply draft.

replyToMessageId.description: If set, create a reply draft to this message id instead of a fresh draft

tools.name: mail.send_mail
tools.description: Send an email from the mailbox immediately. Irreversible once accepted for delivery; the message is saved to Sent Items.
